title: trace: opendrt bake time on the gl thread

commit.merge_subject: merge: trace: opendrt bake time on the gl thread

description: A cache-missing bake logs its duration (ritim-trace) and a device bench renders six distinct specs. Device, 65^3, battery 32.9 C: process-cold first bake 41.9-48.9 ms, warm 28.2-29.3 ms (two runs), render totals 33-59 ms. Not the 300 ms the plan guessed, but about two 60 Hz frames per knob change, so the bake still moves off the render thread in the first F1-8e step.
